Police: He said he was the one who took Xiyuan away.
Police: Xiyuan’s father turned himself in.
Respondent: Oh my, Officer Quan, how could this happen?
Respondent: You must not believe what he says. I’m going right now
Respondent: to the police station.
Respondent: Everything he said is false.
Respondent: It was me. I was the one who instructed him to do it.
Respondent: It’s all my fault.
Respondent: I’m coming right now. I’ll be there soon. Don’t listen to his nonsense. It’s all my responsibility:
